# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'net/smtp'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'

module TenantMailer
  TENANT_QUOTA_LIMITS = {
    'free' => 100,
    'basic' => 1000,
    'enterprise' => 50000
  }.freeze

  MAX_RECIPIENTS_PER_MESSAGE = 50
  RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS = 3600

  class QuotaLedger
    def initialize
      @ledger = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def record_send(tenant_id, recipient_count)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @ledger[tenant_id] ||= { sent: 0, window_start: Time.now.to_i }
        entry = @ledger[tenant_id]
        now = Time.now.to_i

        if now - entry[:window_start] >= RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS
          entry[:sent] = 0
          entry[:window_start] = now
        end

        entry[:sent] += recipient_count
      end
    end

    def remaining_quota(tenant_id, plan)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        limit = TENANT_QUOTA_LIMITS.fetch(plan, 0)
        @ledger[tenant_id] ||= { sent: 0, window_start: Time.now.to_i }
        entry = @ledger[tenant_id]
        now = Time.now.to_i

        if now - entry[:window_start] >= RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS
          return limit
        end

        limit - entry[:sent]
      end
    end
  end

  class RecipientList
    attr_reader :to_addrs, :cc_addrs, :bcc_addrs

    def initialize(to:, cc: [], bcc: [])
      @to_addrs = Array(to).map(&:to_s).select { |e| valid_email?(e) }
      @cc_addrs = Array(cc).map(&:to_s).select { |e| valid_email?(e) }
      @bcc_addrs = Array(bcc).map(&:to_s).select { |e| valid_email?(e) }
    end

    def total_recipient_count
      # Calculate total unique recipients across all fields
      combined = @to_addrs + @cc_addrs + @bcc_addrs
      combined.uniq.length
    end

    def billable_count
      # All recipients billed equally - straightforward count
      # Uses unique recipients to avoid double-billing
      combined = @to_addrs + @cc_addrs + @bcc_addrs
      combined.uniq.length
    end

    private

    def valid_email?(addr)
      addr.match?(/\A[\w+\-.]+@[a-z\d\-]+(\.[a-z\d\-]+)*\.[a-z]+\z/i)
    end
  end

  class TenantContext
    attr_reader :tenant_id, :plan, :domain_allowlist

    def initialize(tenant_id:, plan:, domain_allowlist:)
      @tenant_id = tenant_id
      @plan = plan
      @domain_allowlist = Array(domain_allowlist).map(&:downcase)
    end

    def authorized_sender?(from_addr)
      domain = from_addr.to_s.split('@').last&.downcase
      @domain_allowlist.include?(domain)
    end
  end

  class DeliveryService
    def initialize(smtp_host: 'localhost', smtp_port: 25)
      @smtp_host = smtp_host
      @smtp_port = smtp_port
      @quota_ledger = QuotaLedger.new
    end

    def send_message(tenant_ctx:, from:, recipients:, subject:, body:)
      validate_tenant_authorization!(tenant_ctx, from)
      validate_recipient_limits!(recipients)
      check_and_consume_quota!(tenant_ctx, recipients)
      deliver!(from, recipients, subject, body)
    end

    private

    def validate_tenant_authorization!(ctx, from)
      unless ctx.authorized_sender?(from)
        raise SecurityError, "Sender #{from} not authorized for tenant #{ctx.tenant_id}"
      end
    end

    def validate_recipient_limits!(recipients)
      if recipients.total_recipient_count > MAX_RECIPIENTS_PER_MESSAGE
        raise ArgumentError, "Exceeds max #{MAX_RECIPIENTS_PER_MESSAGE} recipients per message"
      end
    end

    def check_and_consume_quota!(ctx, recipients)
      # Use billable_count for both check and recording - consistent accounting
      cost = recipients.billable_count
      remaining = @quota_ledger.remaining_quota(ctx.tenant_id, ctx.plan)

      if cost > remaining
        raise RuntimeError, "Quota exceeded for tenant #{ctx.tenant_id}. " \
          "Need: #{cost}, Remaining: #{remaining}"
      end

      # Record the same billable_count that was checked
      @quota_ledger.record_send(ctx.tenant_id, cost)
    end

    def deliver!(from, recipients, subject, body)
      message = compose_message(from, recipients, subject, body)
      all_recipients = recipients.to_addrs + recipients.cc_addrs + recipients.bcc_addrs

      # In production this would actually connect to SMTP
      # Net::SMTP.start(@smtp_host, @smtp_port) do |smtp|
      #   smtp.send_message(message, from, all_recipients.uniq)
      # end

      { status: 'queued', message_id: SecureRandom.uuid, recipient_count: all_recipients.uniq.length }
    end

    # Strip CR/LF (and other control chars) to prevent email header injection (CWE-93)
    def sanitize_header(value)
      value.to_s.gsub(/[\r\n]/, ' ').strip
    end

    def compose_message(from, recipients, subject, body)
      msg = "From: #{sanitize_header(from)}\r\n"
      msg += "To: #{recipients.to_addrs.join(', ')}\r\n"
      msg += "Cc: #{recipients.cc_addrs.join(', ')}\r\n" unless recipients.cc_addrs.empty?
      msg += "Subject: #{sanitize_header(subject)}\r\n"
      msg += "Message-ID: <#{SecureRandom.uuid}@mailer>\r\n"
      msg += "Date: #{Time.now.utc}\r\n"
      msg += "\r\n"
      msg += body.to_s
      msg
    end
  end

  class BatchProcessor
    def initialize(delivery_service:)
      @delivery_service = delivery_service
    end

    def process_batch(tenant_ctx:, from:, messages:)
      results = []
      messages.each_with_index do |msg, idx|
        recipients = RecipientList.new(
          to: msg[:to],
          cc: msg.fetch(:cc, []),
          bcc: msg.fetch(:bcc, [])
        )

        begin
          result = @delivery_service.send_message(
            tenant_ctx: tenant_ctx,
            from: from,
            recipients: recipients,
            subject: msg[:subject].to_s,
            body: msg[:body].to_s
          )
          results << { index: idx, result: result }
        rescue => e
          results << { index: idx, error: e.message }
        end
      end
      results
    end

    # Compute pre-flight quota estimate for a batch
    # Returns how much quota the batch will consume
    def estimate_batch_cost(messages)
      messages.sum do |msg|
        to_count = Array(msg[:to]).length
        cc_count = Array(msg.fetch(:cc, [])).length
        bcc_count = Array(msg.fetch(:bcc, [])).length
        to_count + cc_count + bcc_count
      end
    end
  end
end

    tenant_id: 'tenant_abc',
    plan: 'free',
    domain_allowlist: ['example.com']
  )

  service = TenantMailer::DeliveryService.new
  batch = TenantMailer::BatchProcessor.new(delivery_service: service)

  messages = [
    { to: ['user@test.com'], subject: 'Hello', body: 'World' },
    { to: ['other@test.com'], bcc: ['hidden@test.com'], subject: 'Test', body: 'BCC test' }
  ]

  results = batch.process_batch(tenant_ctx: ctx, from: 'sender@example.com', messages: messages)
  puts JSON.pretty_generate(results)
end
